title: Open-LLM-Leaderboard: From Multi-choice to Open-style Questions for LLMs Evaluation, Benchmark, and Arena

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' inherent propensity to favor certain answer choice IDs (e.g., A/B/C/D) in multiple-choice questions by converting established multiple-choice benchmarks into open-style questions and comparing the models' performance across both formats.
